text:
Bring your AI into your Discord servers. Post updates, catch up on messages and route human replies to the right session. Start with whoami, then configure a default channel.
post [<channel>] <text…>: Tell a Discord channel what your assistant did; without a channel, use Configuration default. Answers with channel and message ids.
read [<channel>] [N]: Catch up on a channel, oldest first. Read 1 to 100 messages, default 50; omitted channel uses Configuration default.
channels [filter]: Find text channels in the configured servers, including configured aliases.
channel <channel>: See a channel’s id, name, type and topic.
react <channel> <id> <emoji>: Acknowledge a message with a Unicode or name:id emoji.
edit <channel> <id> <text...>: Correct the text of a message sent by this bot. At most 2,000 characters.
delete <channel> <id>: Remove a message. Discord requires manage-messages permission to delete someone else’s message.
thread <channel> <id> <name...>: Start a named thread from a message; Discord allows one thread per message.
whoami: Check the bot’s identity and its configured servers without sending a Discord message.
sub add <channel> <target> [filter]: Forward each matching channel message to a bus queue or agent, subject to the author’s send rights to both destinations.
sub list: See your subscriptions, including sent and dropped counts; direct Owners and Maintainers see all.
sub delete <id>: Stop your subscription; direct Owners and Maintainers may delete any. To edit, delete it and add it again.
  id (string): Twelve lower-case hexadecimal subscription id

Arguments
channel (string): Configured alias, #name in an allowed server, or numeric channel id
emoji (string): Unicode emoji or custom name:id
filter (string): A common subscription regular expression, or channel-name substring for channels
id (string): Numeric Discord message id
limit (int): 1..100, default 50
name (string): Thread name, 1..100 characters
target (string): Bus queue or agent; the author must be allowed to send to it and this helper
text (string): Plain text; a post is split at 2,000 characters, at most eight parts

v<version> · PolyForm-NC · parf.dev/agent-bus/
Docs: https://github.com/parf/ai-agent-bus/blob/main/docs/agents/discord.md
More: agent-bus help <name> config | secret | json
